<script>
// Feedback A/B test: the feedback persistent buttons show only for sessions in the
// "buttons" group. The group is rendered into the hidden #zt-ab-marker on the scenario
// picker and remembered for the session. Until a group is known the buttons stay hidden,
// so the email-survey group never sees them.
const AB_FEEDBACK_BUTTON_LABELS = ['wrap up this session', 'share feedback'];

function readAbFeedbackGroup() {
  const marker = document.getElementById('zt-ab-marker');
  const key = 'zt_ab_group_' + session_id;
  try {
    if (marker) sessionStorage.setItem(key, marker.textContent.trim());
    return sessionStorage.getItem(key) || '';
  } catch (e) {
    if (marker) window.ztAbGroup = marker.textContent.trim();
    return window.ztAbGroup || '';
  }
}

function applyAbFeedbackButtons() {
  const show = readAbFeedbackGroup() === 'buttons';
  document.querySelectorAll('a, button').forEach(el => {
    if (el.closest('#qa-area') || el.closest('.answers')) return;
    const label = (el.textContent || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!AB_FEEDBACK_BUTTON_LABELS.includes(label)) return;
    if (show) el.style.removeProperty('display');
    else el.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
  });
}

whenEvent('render:finish', () => {
  setTimeout(applyAbFeedbackButtons, 0);
});
</script>

27.content:
# claude.md - Adyen Underperformance Playbook (consolidated single tree) ## Purpose Agent-facing diagnostic playbook for merchant payment underperformance. The agent picks a scenario, answers a short chain of questions, and receives a single Recommended Actions screen, then a summary email closes out the session. Runs in the Adyen agent tool (styles.css + adyenLoader.js loaded via script_code). `${agent}` is expected on the session URL. ## Architecture (one tree, 36 nodes) Replaces the previous 7-tree hub-and-spoke export (Starting Workflow + 6 subtrees, ~70 nodes, ~50 dead ends). Every path now converges on: Build recommended actions (catalog Script) -> Recommended actions (Content, renders `${transforms.outcome_html}`) -> Build readable email summary (Script node 28, stages `${transforms.summary_html}`) -> Email the session summary (renders `${transforms.summary_html}`) -> Summary sent (single terminal). No dead ends. Flow: - Root Script "Extract agent first name" (seeds agent_first_name from the agent query param) -> Content "Select the underperformance scenario" (first rendered screen; back/restart hidden) -> 5 buttons to the branch entry screens. - Each branch = one Content question screen (native conditional form fields) -> one eval Script (sets `outcome_key`, and a routing boolean when the path can continue to another screen) -> optional Scoring router (tests only script-set booleans, or the verbatim competitor checkbox expression). - Terminal outcomes: eval Script (or, for Protect ML, conditional hidden `outcome_key` fields) set `outcome_key` and continue straight to the catalog. - The catalog Script owns an `OUTCOMES` lookup map (outcome_key -> HTML) built from the original nodes' content verbatim; it stages `outcome_html` for the shared Recommended actions screen. Branches: MOB alert (mob -> mob_eval -> mob_router), Sanity checks (sanity -> sanity_eval -> sanity_router), Deeper diagnostics (deep -> deep_eval -> deep_router), Competitor comparison (competitor -> competitor_router), Payment Conversion Rate (pcr -> pcr_eval -> pcr_router -> protectml), Fraud rate (fraud -> fraud_eval), Decline reasons (decline -> decline_eval; shared - reached from deep_router, competitor_router). ## Data dictionary Inbound query param: `agent` (email in the form firstname.lastname@domain; used for greeting + email recipient). Derived variable: `agent_first_name` = text before the first period of `agent`. Created by the root Script node "Extract agent first name" via `ZT.setFormData` (runs before anything renders, so it displays on the picker and is captured in the session/transcript/email). The root is a Script node on purpose - seeding data from query params is a standard entry pattern. Form variables (native selects unless noted): - mob_recovered, mob_has_advice, mob_advice; mob_go_sanity (bool, script) - seasonality_effect, new_or_different_traffic, merchant_is_initiating_more_retries; sanity_go_deep (bool) - issuer_bin, oneoff_platform, experiments; deep_go_decline (bool) - sameTrafficAndSetup, same_success_metrics, comparison_valid (checkboxes, checkbox_score=1) - competitor_router tests `comparison_valid == 1` (op-based Scoring, verbatim from source) - pcr_significant, pcr; pcr_go_protect (bool) - protect_ml_adopted - protect_premium, fraud_ml, fraud_main_provider, fraud_recs, fraud_diff; fraud_all_confirmed ("yes"/"no") - decline_reason, au_nto, no_specific_product - outcome_key (string, drives the catalog); overwrite-safe plain hidden `outcome_key="comparison_not_fair"` on the competitor screen is re-set downstream when the fair path continues to decline. Transforms: - outcome_html (produced by catalog Script or directly by sanity_eval when outcome_key="prebuilt"; consumed by the Recommended actions Content node). - summary_html (produced by node 28 "Build readable email summary"; a human-readable session summary = scenario + a Question/Answer table of the captured selects + the recommended-actions HTML with its links. Referenced by the Email node body as `${transforms.summary_html}`. Transform data is renderable in the Email node per the Transformation Functions reference.) ## External systems None. No CX Actions / Connected Objects - confirmed static (Brent, Jul 2026). All screens are static guidance + links to Adyen dashboards/Confluence/Slack, preserved verbatim from the source trees. ## Conventions & gotchas - The Email node (24) renders `${transforms.summary_html}` (built by node 28) instead of `##TRANSCRIPT##`. Zingtree's raw `##TRANSCRIPT##` output (node titles + styled `.ghd-btn` button spans) was hard to read and did NOT include the consolidated dynamic recommendation, so the emailed summary looked empty/link-less. A script cannot read `##TRANSCRIPT##` (no transcript namespace), so node 28 REBUILDS the Q&A from the captured form variables (fixed question set -> stable layout) and appends `transforms.outcome_html` (links intact). Recipient stays `${agent}`. `email_include_session_data="1"` is left as-is (appends raw session data below the summary; toggle off in the editor if you want the email to show only the formatted summary). - `merge_vars_not_fixed="1"` is REQUIRED: the shared Recommended actions node renders `${transforms.outcome_html}` staged per path; without it the first-rendered value would stick. - Routers use `advanced_logic_node="1"` + empty fallback and test script booleans (`flag == true`) - except competitor_router which is the org-proven op-based checkbox Scoring (`comparison_valid == 1`, advanced_logic_node="0"). - Native `select` (Yes/No) used instead of the source's checkboxes/radios wherever a script reads the answer (reliably readable, enforces `required`). The four Fraud verification checkboxes became Yes/No selects; fraud_all_confirmed drives whether the outcome prepends the "not all confirmed" alert. - Conditional fields (`config.conditional.simple`) collapse each branch's dependent questions onto one screen. - Protect ML uses two conditional hidden `outcome_key` fields (mutually exclusive) - dev-test the duplicate-name behavior once in Zingtree. ## Feedback A/B test (CR-1) Requirements: `Zingtree Builder/Requirements/Adyen/underperformance-playbook-requirements.md` (CR-1). - Root Script 1 seeds `agent_first_name`, then continues to node 29, a Logic node in **A/B test** mode (random 50/50; continuation falls back to row A if the engine ever evaluates it as a plain logic node). Row A -> Script 30 sets `ab_group="buttons"`; row B -> Script 31 sets `ab_group="survey"`. Both continue to the picker (2). - Group A: persistent buttons "Wrap up this session" (-> 32) and "Share feedback" (-> 26) on every screen. Group B: both hidden by the script_code block below. - The picker renders `${ab_group}` into a hidden `#zt-ab-marker` span; script_code reads it on `render:finish`, stores it in sessionStorage keyed by `session_id`, and hides any non-answer button labelled "Wrap up this session" / "Share feedback" unless the group is `buttons`. Fails closed (hidden) when no group is known. If either persistent button is renamed, update `AB_FEEDBACK_BUTTON_LABELS`. - Wrap-up screen 32 (native select `wrapup_outcome` required + `wrapup_comment` optional, persistent buttons hidden) -> Script 33 stages `transforms.wrapup_thanks_html` -> Content 34 (terminal). - After the summary email (24) -> Router 35: `ab_group == "survey"` -> Email 36 (survey link to `/show/629304572?ab_group=survey#32`, recipient `${agent}`) -> 25; else -> 25. - Reading the test: per group, sessions started (`ab_group`) vs sessions with `wrapup_outcome` set. Group B survey sessions start at node 32 with `ab_group=survey` from the URL and carry no agent identity. - To end the test: point Script 1's continuation back to 2 (nodes 29-31, 35-36 become unreachable), or set node 29 to always pick one row. ## Back/Restart (front-end hide on first screen only) The per-node `hide_back_restart` field did not work in the 2026 Vue theme, so hiding is done with front-end JS in the tree `script_code`: the first content node carries a hidden ``, and a MutationObserver hides any Back/Restart control (matched by id pattern or button text `back`/`restart`/`start over`, excluding `#qa-area`/`.answers` answer buttons) whenever that marker is present, restoring them on every other node. Tree-wide `hide_back_button`/`show_restart_button` stay at defaults so the buttons remain on the diagnostic screens. `hide_back_restart="1"` is also left on the picker as a harmless belt-and-suspenders. If the theme's Back/Restart use different markup, widen `isNav()` in script_code. ## Changelog - 2026-10-05 - Feedback A/B test, CR-1 (prompt: "A/B node as the starting node; one group gets the current flow with a survey, the other gets persistent feedback buttons") - Added A/B Logic node 29 after the seed script with group scripts 30/31 (`ab_group`); marker span on picker 2; persistent button "Wrap up this session" -> new wrap-up screen 32 -> confirmation script 33 -> terminal 34; router 35 + survey Email 36 after the summary email for the survey group; script_code block hiding feedback persistent buttons outside group A. Node 1 continuation 2 -> 29, node 24 continuation 25 -> 35. Nodes 28 -> 36. New vars ab_group, wrapup_outcome, wrapup_comment; new transform wrapup_thanks_html. - 2026-07-30 - Email summary restored + made readable (prompt: "no more links / email summary missing; add a script to parse the transcript into a readable transforms var referenced in the email") - Root cause: the Email node used `

##TRANSCRIPT##

`, which does not capture the consolidated dynamic `${transforms.outcome_html}` recommendation, so the email arrived without the summary or its links (on-screen links were fine). Added Script node 28 "Build readable email summary" that rebuilds a clean scenario + Q/A table from the captured selects and appends the recommended-actions HTML (links intact) into `transforms.summary_html`; rewired Recommended actions (23) Finish button 24 -> 28 -> 24; set Email body to `${transforms.summary_html}`.
